items.highlights: Every GPU that runs an AI workload generates heat. Every AI data center needs power before a single chip can operate. Vertiv sits at the intersection of both problems and just posted its second consecutive quarter of raised full-year guidance. The stock fell on the Q2 print anyway, purely on a revenue timing miss that management explained clearly. A $6.65 to $6.75 full-year adjusted EPS guide, up from $6.30 to $6.40 after Q1, is not a business slowing down. It is a business accelerating faster than the market gave it credit for today. ... - Vertiv reported Q2 2026 net sales of $3.274 billion
